name: devflow-done
description: Whether a work item's work is finished, given the item and the evidence in the state. devflow's gate asks criteriaMet once per acceptance criterion.

criteriaMet.instructions: Does the state show every acceptance criterion of the work item met?

criteria.true: each criterion the work item states is shown satisfied by the changes or their output
criteria.false: a criterion is missing, unaddressed, or only claimed without evidence

verified.instructions: Does the state show the relevant checks or tests ran and passed?

criteria.true: test or check output covering the change is present and passing
criteria.false: no output, checks skipped, or failures present

inScope.instructions: Do the changes stay within what the work item asked for, without unrelated edits?
